registry_name: US candidates for post-2020 adaptive genetic-algorithm reproduction
language_note: Unknown information is recorded exactly as Не вказано.

evidence_legend.paper: Claim stated in the candidate paper or its official bibliographic record.
evidence_legend.repository: Claim observed in an author or institutional repository.
evidence_legend.inference: Explicit audit inference; not represented as a statement made by the authors.

scoring_formula: final_score = mathematical_description_completeness + experimental_parameter_completeness + legal_data_availability + random_seeds_and_run_count + open_code + code_license_quality + intermediate_result_verifiability + adaptive_parameter_description_completeness + update_order_clarity + baseline_ga + ablation_study

candidates.full_title: [paper:P1 p.1] Calibration of an Adaptive Genetic Algorithm for Modeling Opinion Diffusion
candidates.authors: [paper:P1 p.1] Kara Layne Johnson; Nicole Bohme Carnegie
candidates.author_institutions: [paper:P1 p.1] Department of Mathematical Sciences, Montana State University, Bozeman, Montana, USA
candidates.decision_variable_count: [paper:P1 §§2.1.1, 2.2, Table 5] P = sum(i,j) a_ij, the number of non-structurally-zero weights in W. Experiments use N=4,20,50 and minimum graph degree 1 with self-links. [inference] For N=20, at least two admissible weights per row give P>=40 stored weights and at least 20 independent row-simplex coordinates; therefore the >10 criterion is satisfied.
candidates.decision_variables: [paper:P1 Eq. (1), §§2.1.1 and 2.2] Complete symbolic list: {w_ij : i=1,...,N; j=1,...,N; a_ij=1}. Each w_ij is the influence assigned by agent i to agent j; weights with a_ij=0 are fixed at zero. For any selected N=20 instance this is w_11,...,w_20,20 restricted to entries whose adjacency value is one.
candidates.decision_variable_types: [paper:P1 §2.1.1] continuous; every free w_ij is in [0,1].
candidates.ga_hyperparameters: [paper:P1 Table 1, pp.7-8] chromosomes; probb; factorb; maxb; iterb; probc; factorc; minc; iterc; probm; factorm; minm; iterm; sigma; factors; mins; iters; max_iter; min_improve; min_dev; reintroduce; iterr.
candidates.adaptive_parameters: [paper:P1 §2.2.3, pp.5-6] Numeric control parameters p_b (blending probability), p_c (crossover probability), p_m (mutation probability), and sigma (Gaussian mutation standard deviation). A stagnation-triggered chromosome-reintroduction action is also used but is not counted as a numeric adaptive parameter.
candidates.adaptation_category: [paper:P1 §2.2.3] Category E, feedback-based multi-parameter adaptive GA
candidates.simultaneous_or_sequential: [paper:P1 §2.3.1] Simultaneous when the common stagnation horizon is reached; iterb, iterc, iterm, iters, and iterr use the same selected value within a run.
candidates.adaptation_level: [paper:P1 §§2.2.2-2.2.3] Population/generation-level control of operator probabilities and mutation magnitude.
candidates.adaptation_formulas: [paper:P1 §2.2.3, p.6] Example stated explicitly: p_b_new = min(maxb, factorb*p_b). By the stated analogous multiplicative rule, p_c_new=max(minc,factorc*p_c), p_m_new=max(minm,factorm*p_m), sigma_new=max(mins,factors*sigma). [inference] min/max wrappers express the paper's instruction to stop changing a control at its bound.
candidates.adaptive_min_values: [paper:P1 Table 3, pp.8-9] p_c/p_m/sigma lower bounds by MinMax level: minimal=(0,0,0), moderate=(0.01,0.01,0.01), extreme=(0.05,0.05,0.05). p_b only increases, so its run-specific initial value is its effective lower bound.
candidates.adaptive_max_values: [paper:P1 Table 3, pp.8-9] p_b upper bound maxb is 1 (minimal), 0.5 (moderate), or 0.2 (extreme). Because p_c, p_m, and sigma only decrease, their run-specific initial values are their effective maxima.
candidates.update_frequency: [paper:P1 §2.3.1] After 200, 1000, or 5000 generations without objective improvement; the same horizon is assigned to iterb, iterc, iterm, iters, and iterr within a run. The stop check is performed every 1000 generations.
candidates.update_order: [paper:P1 §§2.2.2-2.2.3] In each generation: selection and possible gene swap, blending, crossover, mutation, survival; after the stagnation test the four controls are multiplied and clamped, and the configured chromosome is reintroduced when its horizon is met.
candidates.adaptation_input_metrics: [paper:P1 §2.2.3] Number of generations since the last improvement in the objective function.
candidates.parameter_interdependence: [paper:P1 §2.3.1] The four controls share a stagnation signal and grouped experimental levels (ProbSigma, MinMax, MultFactor); each control uses its own factor and bound.
candidates.page_and_formula_number: [paper:P1] DeGroot model Eq. (1), p.3; objective Eqs. (2a)-(2b), p.4; blending Eq. (3), p.5; adaptive example p_b_new=c*p_b in §2.2.3, p.6; hyperparameters Tables 1-5, pp.7-9.
candidates.pseudocode_available: [paper:P1 Figure 2 and §§2.2-2.3] No numbered GA pseudocode block; a calibration flow diagram, complete operator descriptions, update formula, tables, and public code provide a sufficient algorithmic description.
candidates.baseline_ga_available: [paper:P1] No fixed-parameter baseline GA is reported in this calibration study.
candidates.ablation_study_available: [paper:P1 Tables 2-5] No classical one-component ablation; the paper instead uses a factorial calibration/sensitivity design over grouped hyperparameters.
candidates.optimization_task_type: [paper:P1 §§2.1-2.2] Continuous constrained parameter estimation for a DeGroot opinion-diffusion model.
candidates.fitness_function: [paper:P1 Eqs. (2a)-(2b), p.4] Minimize sum over agents and time of ordinal-bin deviation B(xhat_i(t),x_i(t)) multiplied by absolute continuous opinion deviation.
candidates.constraint_handling: [paper:P1 §§2.1.1, 2.2.2] Structural zeros are fixed by adjacency; each row is kept in [0,1] and sums to one. Blending and crossover preserve row sums; mutation clips the changed weight and rescales remaining free weights.
candidates.penalty_function: [paper:P1 Eqs. (2a)-(2b)] The ordinal-bin multiplier is part of the objective; no separate constraint-violation penalty is used.
candidates.dataset_or_benchmark: [paper:P1 §2.3.2, Table 5] Synthetic connected Erdos-Renyi networks with N={4,20,50}, mean-degree targets {2,5,9}, self-weight target 0.5, T={2,3,6}, ordinal bins {5,7,10,20,30}, and all hyperparameter combinations; a new network, W, and dataset are generated for each run.
candidates.data_url: [paper:P1 Data Availability, p.15; repository:R1] https://github.com/karajohnson4/DeGrootGeneticAlgorithm (file hyper.csv.zip / Simulation-Study-Data)
candidates.original_code_language: [paper:P1 Data Availability, p.15; repository:R1] Julia 1.5 or higher; repository language listing is Julia 100%.
candidates.code_license: [paper:P1 Data Availability, p.15; repository:R1] GNU GPL v3. Use, modification, and redistribution are permitted under GPL terms; a distributed derivative must remain GPL and is not suitable for copying into an MIT-only implementation.
candidates.complete_parameter_set_available: [paper:P1 Tables 1-5] Yes for the reported calibration design; random seeds remain absent.
candidates.independent_run_count: [paper:P1 §2.3.2, p.9] Ten runs for every simulation-study combination, with a new network, weight matrix, and dataset each time.
candidates.published_metrics: [paper:P1 Eq. (4), Figures 3-7, §3] Recovery RMSE; objective success/perfect-solution rate; generations to solution; computation time. The paper reports 67.7% perfect within 1000 generations and 4.5% not perfect by 100000 generations.
candidates.intermediate_results_available: [paper:P1 Figures 3-7; repository:R1] Yes: factor-level plots and the hyper.csv.zip simulation output permit checks below the final aggregate.
candidates.convergence_curve_available: [paper:P1] No generation-by-generation raw convergence curve; only time/generation-to-solution summaries and distributions.
candidates.raw_data_available: [repository:R1] Yes for reported simulation-study output in hyper.csv.zip; generated random inputs and seeds are not separately documented.
candidates.reproducibility_level: [deep-audit inference] High for distribution-level verification with a clean-room MATLAB implementation; exact stochastic replay remains impossible without seeds and the archived simulation driver.
candidates.main_risks: [deep-audit inference] Missing seeds; no archived simulation driver or locked Julia environment; GPL-3.0 copyleft blocks copying into an MIT-only derivative; a hard-coded elite-index comparison in SelectionOperator.jl can mishandle some populations.
candidates.inclusion_or_exclusion_reason: [deep-audit inference] Included: 2022 US paper, lawful full text, >10 independent W coordinates, explicit four-control stagnation adaptation, reconstructible synthetic inputs, public GPL-3.0 Julia operators, and raw simulation outputs. Use a clean-room MATLAB port for an MIT deliverable.

P1.locators: pp.1-15; §§2.1-2.3; Eqs.1-4; Tables1-5; Figures2-7; Data Availability

candidates.full_title: [paper:P1 p.1] Using a novel genetic algorithm to assess peer influence on willingness to use pre-exposure prophylaxis in networks of Black men who have sex with men
candidates.authors: [paper:P1 p.1] Kara Layne Johnson; Jennifer L. Walsh; Yuri A. Amirkhanian; John J. Borkowski; Nicole Bohme Carnegie
candidates.venue: [paper:P1 p.1] Applied Network Science, volume 6, article 22
candidates.legal_open_access_url: [paper:P1/O1] Official publisher CC BY 4.0 PDF: https://appliednetsci.springeropen.com/counter/pdf/10.1007/s41109-020-00347-2.pdf ; institutional CC BY record: https://scholarworks.montana.edu/items/7cfc71c3-9b71-4306-932e-5a7219fc4e21
candidates.author_institutions: [paper:P1 pp.1,39] Department of Mathematical Sciences, Montana State University, Bozeman, Montana; Center for AIDS Intervention Research, Medical College of Wisconsin, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
candidates.decision_variable_count: [paper:P1 pp.5-6 and Table 2] P is the count of nonzero-eligible entries of W. Simulations use N={4,10,20,50}, degree targets {2,5,9}, and self-links. [inference] The N=10,d=9 complete-network case stores 100 weights and has 90 independent coordinates after ten row-sum constraints; the hard dimensional criterion is satisfied.
candidates.decision_variables: [paper:P1 DeGroot and Genetic algorithm subsections, pp.5-6; repository:R1] {w_ij : i=1,...,N; j=1,...,N; a_ij=1}. For N=10,d=9, native storage is rows W1,...,W10 with w_i1,...,w_i10; neither source defines a unique flattened ordering of the 90 independent coordinates.
candidates.ga_hyperparameters: [paper:P1 Table 1] chromosomes; probb; factorb; maxb; iterb; probc; factorc; minc; iterc; probm; factorm; minm; iterm; sigma; factors; mins; iters; max_iter; min_improve; min_dev; reintroduce; iterr.
candidates.adaptive_parameters: [paper:P1 pp.9-10] p_b blending probability; p_c crossover probability; p_m mutation probability; sigma Gaussian-mutation standard deviation. Elite-chromosome reintroduction after stagnation is an additional triggered replacement event.
candidates.adaptation_category: [paper:P1 pp.9-10] Category E, feedback-based multi-parameter adaptive GA
candidates.simultaneous_or_sequential: [paper:P1 Table 1] The three probabilities are eligible for simultaneous update at 1000 stagnant iterations; sigma updates at 2000; elite reintroduction at 2500, so the overall schedule is partly simultaneous and partly sequential.
candidates.adaptation_formulas: [paper:P1 p.9 and Table 1] p_b_new=min(0.2,2*p_b); p_c_new=max(0,0.5*p_c); p_m_new=max(0.01,0.5*p_m); sigma_new=max(0.001,0.5*sigma). [repository:R1] Archived code uses strict > threshold tests, so its counter semantics update one iteration later than the paper's when-reached description.
candidates.adaptive_min_values: [paper:P1 Table 1] p_c minimum 0; p_m minimum 0.01; sigma minimum 0.001; p_b only increases and therefore has effective minimum 0.01.
candidates.adaptive_max_values: [paper:P1 Table 1] p_b maximum 0.2; p_c, p_m, and sigma only decrease and therefore their starting values 0.2, 0.2, and 1 are effective maxima.
candidates.update_frequency: [paper:P1 Table 1] p_b, p_c, p_m at 1000 iterations without improvement; sigma at 2000; elite reintroduction at 2500. [repository:R1] Strict > checks trigger at counter values 1001, 2001, and 2501.
candidates.update_order: [paper:P1 pp.7-10] Gene swapping and elitist selection; blending; within-chromosome crossover; Gaussian mutation; survival; stagnation-driven control update/reintroduction. [repository:R1] Selection hard-codes elite index 5 and blending aliases the first child into the parent used for the second child, so exact released semantics conflict with the paper.
candidates.parameter_interdependence: [paper:P1 Table 1] Shared objective-improvement feedback; each parameter has its own factor, bound, and horizon.
candidates.page_and_formula_number: [paper:P1] DeGroot model p.5; chromosome/objective pp.6-7; blending equation p.8; mutation and adaptive mechanism pp.9-10; full values Table 1 pp.10-11; simulation factors Table 2 p.11.
candidates.pseudocode_available: [paper:P1 pp.6-10] No numbered pseudocode block. Operator prose/equations and public source exist, but the archived source conflicts with the paper and no study driver identifies the executed variant.
candidates.baseline_ga_available: [paper:P1] No fixed-parameter baseline GA is reported.
candidates.optimization_task_type: [paper:P1 pp.5-6] Continuous constrained DeGroot weight-matrix estimation from short opinion time series.
candidates.fitness_function: [paper:P1 objective subsection, pp.6-7] Minimize f_C(Xhat,X)=sum_i sum_t (xhat_i(t)-x_i(t))^2; an agent-level version is used for gene swapping.
candidates.constraint_handling: [paper:P1 pp.5,9] w_ij=0 for absent ties; all weights remain in [0,1]; each row sums to one. Mutation clips the changed weight and rescales the other free row entries; blending/crossover preserve feasibility.
candidates.penalty_function: [paper:P1] No separate constraint penalty; feasibility is preserved by representation and repair/rescaling.
candidates.dataset_or_benchmark: [paper:P1 Table 2 and pp.10-12] Synthetic connected Erdos-Renyi networks: N={4,10,20,50}, d={2,5,9}, self-weight={0.1,0.5,0.8}, T={2,3,6,11}, missingness={0,10,25,50} percent; plus five restricted PrEP pilot networks. The paper says remaining row weight is randomly distributed but does not specify the law or generator.
candidates.data_url: [paper:P1 Data and materials, pp.38-39; repository:R1] Pinned result CSV directory: https://github.com/karajohnson4/DeGrootGeneticAlgorithm/tree/cd5c852f4b02b5b620a28263a14bf008218d6e2c/Simulation-Study-Data . Pilot inputs are restricted.
candidates.data_license: [audit 2026-07-30] Article is CC BY 4.0, but no root/data-directory or CSV-specific license was found at the pinned commit. The GPL file is inside Algorithm-Code and does not establish CSV redistribution rights.
candidates.code_url: [paper:P1 Data and materials, pp.38-39; repository:R1] Pinned ANS-Archive tree: https://github.com/karajohnson4/DeGrootGeneticAlgorithm/tree/cd5c852f4b02b5b620a28263a14bf008218d6e2c/Algorithm-Code
candidates.original_code_language: [paper:P1 pp.38-39; repository:R1] Julia 1.5 or higher; paper says analysis used R, but no R analysis script is archived.
candidates.code_license: [paper:P1 pp.38-39; repository:R1] GNU GPL version 3 text is present in Algorithm-Code/LICENSE at commit cd5c852f4b02b5b620a28263a14bf008218d6e2c; no broader per-file grant was located.
candidates.complete_parameter_set_available: [audit 2026-07-30] No for an exact experiment: Table 1 gives 22 GA settings, but generator, driver, seeds, input matrices, initial populations, analysis script, and exact off-diagonal weight law are absent.
candidates.random_seeds_available: [paper:P1; repository:R1] No seeds are reported or archived.
candidates.independent_run_count: [paper:P1 simulation methods, p.11] The GA was run ten times per generated dataset. Seeds and the experiment driver are absent.
candidates.published_metrics: [paper:P1 pp.12-22, Tables 4-10, Figures 1-12] Fit, extrapolation, and recovery RMSE with medians/IQRs. [audit 2026-07-30] Public N=10,d=9 type-7 recovery rows give 0.16 (0.11) under ordinary rounding, while Table 4 reports 0.15 (0.10); no analysis script resolves this.
candidates.intermediate_results_available: [repository:R1] Output tables only: fit.csv has 78000 records, including 14040 all-zero placeholders; recovery.csv has 3900 records, including 702 all-zero placeholders. No matrices, trajectories, initial populations, or per-run seed ledger.
candidates.convergence_curve_available: [paper:P1] No raw generation-by-generation convergence trajectory was located.
candidates.raw_data_available: [audit 2026-07-30; repository:R1] No rerunnable raw inputs. The deposit contains only incomplete result CSVs: recovery 3198 non-placeholder of 3900 rows and fit 63960 non-placeholder of 78000 rows. Pilot raw data are restricted.
candidates.reproducibility_level: [audit 2026-07-30] Very low for exact GA reproduction; only an output-only descriptive reanalysis of the archived CSVs is possible, subject to unresolved CSV licensing.
candidates.main_risks: [audit 2026-07-30] Missing generator, driver, seeds, A/W/X inputs, initial populations, analysis code, and environment; off-diagonal weight law is underspecified; result CSVs are incomplete and lack an explicit data license; pilot data are restricted; strict-threshold, elite-index, and aliased-blending code conflict with the paper.
candidates.inclusion_or_exclusion_reason: [audit 2026-07-30] Excluded: the critical available-or-reproducible-input-data condition fails. Reproducing the reported GA would require inventing inputs and choosing among conflicting paper/code semantics; archived outputs are not a substitute for those inputs.

candidates.full_title: [paper:P1 p.1] Genetic algorithms with self-adaptation for predictive classification of Medicare standardized payments for physical therapists
candidates.authors: [paper:P1 p.1] Reamonn Norat; Annie S. Wu; Xinliang Liu
candidates.venue: [paper:P1 p.1] Expert Systems with Applications, volume 218, article 119529
candidates.author_institutions: [paper:P1 p.1] Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering and Department of Computer Science, University of Central Florida, Orlando, Florida; Department of Community and Population Health, Lehigh University, Bethlehem, Pennsylvania
candidates.decision_variable_count: [audit 2026-07-30] The dimensional threshold passes: 51 solution-chromosome genes, comprising one intercept, 25 predictor coefficients, and 25 exponent-selector loci. The separate 23-gene adaptive chromosome is not needed to reach ≥11.
candidates.decision_variables: [paper:P1 Table 2 and Eqs. (2)-(3), pp.4-5] c0 intercept; c1-c25 coefficients for, respectively: gender; Doctor of Physical Therapy degree; number of unique HCPCS/CPT codes billed; number of beneficiaries; billed-charge/allowed-amount ratio; average standardized payment per beneficiary; percent physical agents; percent therapeutic procedures; number of new patients; average beneficiary age; average HCC risk; small-metro indicator; mid-sized-metro indicator; non-metro indicator; standardized risk-adjusted per-capita Medicare costs; primary-care physicians per 10000 population; PTs per 10000 population; percent Medicaid-eligible beneficiaries; county average beneficiary age; county percent female beneficiaries; county average HCC risk; beneficiaries percent of county population; median household income; percent persons 65+ in deep poverty; PTs per 10000 beneficiaries. c26-c50 are the corresponding exponent-selector genes for those same 25 features.
candidates.decision_variable_types: [paper:P1 §4.2] continuous genes in [-1,1]; c26-c50 are continuously encoded but categorically map to integer exponents {1,2,3,4}.
candidates.ga_hyperparameter_count: [audit 2026-07-30] 26 encoded/fixed controls are named: population, generation limit, tournament size, and 23 adaptive loci. This count does not imply completeness because ten operator-argument mappings and multiple execution semantics are absent.
candidates.ga_hyperparameters: [audit 2026-07-30] Fixed: population=100, 200 generations, tournament size=10. Adaptive p0 mutation rate; p1 Gaussian fitness; p2 Gaussian argument; p3 polynomial fitness; p4 polynomial argument; p5 uniform-random fitness; p6 crossover rate; p7 two-point fitness; p8 SBX fitness; p9 SBX argument; p10 blend fitness; p11 blend argument; p12 arithmetic fitness; p13 arithmetic argument; p14 linear fitness; p15 simplex fitness; p16 simplex argument; p17 PCX fitness; p18-p19 PCX arguments; p20 UNDX fitness; p21-p22 UNDX arguments. Target ranges/mappings for the ten arguments are not supplied.
candidates.adaptive_parameters: [paper:P1 Table 7] All p0-p22 parameter-chromosome loci: mutation and crossover rates, 11 operator-fitness/selection weights, and 10 operator arguments.
candidates.simultaneous_or_sequential: [audit 2026-07-30] Broadly co-evolved with the solution, but not executable exactly: the paper does not state whether pre- or post-mutation controls govern parameter self-mutation, whether stochastic events are shared across chromosomes, or how the no-crossover branch inherits parameters.
candidates.adaptation_level: [paper:P1 §§4.3, Algorithms 2-3] Individual/chromosome level for rates and operator settings; operator level for operator selection.
candidates.adaptation_formulas: [audit 2026-07-30] Stated core: p0-p22 evolve with the individual; effective parent crossover rate/operator fitness is the arithmetic mean; Algorithm 3 sorts operators by fitness and accepts each nonlast candidate when U(0,1)<0.9. Missing: ten argument target ranges/maps, operator variants, boundaries, tie ordering, no-crossover inheritance, self-mutation timing, and multi-parent accounting.
candidates.adaptive_initial_values: [paper:P1 §4.3, p.6] Every p0-p22 is initialized independently and uniformly in [0,1].
candidates.adaptive_min_values: [audit 2026-07-30] Encoded p_i lower bound is reported as 0, but decoded minima for operator arguments are not supplied and boundary-repair behavior is absent.
candidates.adaptive_max_values: [audit 2026-07-30] Encoded p_i upper bound is reported as 1, but decoded maxima for operator arguments are not supplied and boundary-repair behavior is absent.
candidates.update_frequency: [audit 2026-07-30] Parameter genes are intended to recombine/mutate whenever their individual is reproduced; exact per-individual versus per-locus mutation semantics and the controlling pre/post state are not stated.
candidates.update_order: [audit 2026-07-30] Broad order: evaluate → tournament-select → choose crossover → reproduce solution/parameter chromosomes → choose mutation per child → mutate → generational replacement. Exact parent count, offspring accounting, no-crossover branch, parameter self-mutation, bounds, ties, and replacement truncation are missing.
candidates.adaptation_input_metrics: [paper:P1 §4.3] Evolutionary survival/fitness of individuals carrying the parameter genes; there is no explicit population-feedback formula.
candidates.parameter_interdependence: [audit 2026-07-30] All 23 loci travel with the solution and parents' crossover controls are averaged, but the self-referential mutation/control timing and shared-versus-separate chromosome operations are unresolved.
candidates.page_and_formula_number: [audit 2026-07-30] Eqs. (2)-(4) representation/classification; Table 3 canonical GA; Algorithm 2 broad SAGA loop; Tables 5-7 operators/23 loci; Algorithm 3 rank-based operator selection; Eqs. (5)-(6) standardization; Tables 8-9 50-run targets.
candidates.pseudocode_available: [audit 2026-07-30] Algorithms 2-3 provide a broad loop and rank-selection process, not an exact implementation: argument maps, operator definitions, boundaries, parent/offspring accounting, self-mutation state, ties, and no-crossover behavior are absent.
candidates.baseline_ga_available: [paper:P1 Table 3 and §5] Yes: canonical GA with population 100, 200 generations, tournament size 10, two-point crossover rate 0.9, uniform-random mutation rate 0.2; logistic regression is an additional benchmark.
candidates.ablation_study_available: [audit 2026-07-30] No component-wise adaptive ablation. Raw/standardized and feature-subset experiments do not isolate rates, operator choice, or argument self-adaptation.
candidates.optimization_task_type: [paper:P1 §§3-5] Binary predictive classification and embedded feature selection.
candidates.fitness_function: [paper:P1 Eqs. (2)-(4), §5] Percentage of correctly classified training observations, where prediction_j=c0+sum_i c_i' v_ij and the label is one iff prediction_j>0.
candidates.constraint_handling: [audit 2026-07-30] Solution genes are intended to remain in [-1,1] and parameter genes in [0,1], but clipping/reflection/resampling/rejection is unspecified. Equation (3) excludes selector endpoint 1.0 despite inclusive initialization.
candidates.penalty_function: [audit 2026-07-30] No penalty or exact alternative boundary-repair procedure is reported.
candidates.dataset_or_benchmark: [audit 2026-07-30] Exact input is an unavailable 40662×25 analytic table derived from the 2014 CMS Physician/Other Supplier PUF and 2015-2016 HRSA AHRF, tested raw/standardized with train:test 50:50, 25:75, 10:90, 5:95, 1:99.
candidates.data_url: [audit 2026-07-30] The processed analytic table and splits are not public; the paper says data will be made available on request. Official upstream sources: https://www.hhs.gov/guidance/document/physician-and-other-supplier-data-cy-2014 and https://data.hrsa.gov/data/download?AHRF=&data=AHRF
candidates.data_license: [audit 2026-07-30] HRSA reports no AHRF usage limitation; historical CMS files are public but include an AMA CPT/HCPCS license boundary. No deposited derived table or artifact-specific license exists.
candidates.code_url: [audit 2026-07-30] No official source repository, supplement, release, commit, or immutable code archive was identified.
candidates.original_code_language: [audit 2026-07-30] GA/SAGA language is not reported. Logistic regression uses scikit-learn in Python, without a version or configuration lock.
candidates.code_license: [audit 2026-07-30] None available because no GA/SAGA code artifact was identified. The Elsevier article is not a source-code license.
candidates.license_url: [audit 2026-07-30] No code/derived-data license. Institutionally hosted article is © 2023 Elsevier Ltd.; HRSA AHRF catalog reports usage limitations: none.
candidates.complete_parameter_set_available: [audit 2026-07-30] No. Missing analytic rows/splits, ten argument mappings, exact operator variants, boundaries, per-locus/event rate meaning, no-crossover inheritance, self-mutation timing, multi-parent accounting, ties, replacement, RNG, and environment.
candidates.random_seeds_available: [audit 2026-07-30] No GA, split, or logistic-regression seeds; no RNG family/state or seed ledger.
candidates.independent_run_count: [audit 2026-07-30] The paper explicitly reports 50 GA/SAGA runs for each configuration, but supplies no seeds or 50-value raw vectors.
candidates.published_metrics: [audit 2026-07-30] Tables 8-9 report best and 50-run mean accuracy with labelled 95% CIs. Table 9 SD-SAGA test mean±CI for test shares 50/75/90/95/99%: 93.15±0.54, 93.25±0.49, 92.40±1.92, 91.91±1.89, 87.92±3.02.
candidates.intermediate_results_available: [audit 2026-07-30] Aggregate tables and coefficient/parameter figures exist, but no per-run accuracies, genomes, parameter chromosomes, split memberships, predictions, or generation histories.
candidates.convergence_curve_available: [audit 2026-07-30] No machine-readable per-generation convergence trace was located.
